info.title: Fault Code API
info.description: Fault Code REST API: list, get, create, update and delete incidents, vehicles, drivers, notifications, fault codes and ontology. Send a dedicated Fault Code Entra access token in the Authorization: Bearer header. The API validates signature, issuer, audience, expiry, scopes and roles. Limit: 200 authorized API requests per identity per UTC day, shared across endpoints. Resets at midnight UTC. Refreshing a token does not reset usage; excess requests return 429 with Retry-After.

get.description: Requires drivers.read. Delegated: exact scope drivers.read AND one of roles Reader, Operator, Engineer, Administrator. Application: exact role Drivers.Read.All. Caller kind: Either. Alternatively exact drivers.read.own scope AND Reader role; application own-read is unavailable. Trusted record authorization remains required. Daily quota: 200 authorized API requests per identity across all endpoints; resets at midnight UTC. Token refresh does not reset usage. Quota exhaustion returns 429 with Retry-After and X-RateLimit-Limit, X-RateLimit-Remaining and X-RateLimit-Reset headers. Authorized tenant-filtered fleet records. Lists are paginated after ownership filtering. Vehicles include associated drivers visible to the caller and fault codes when knowledge.read is granted. Creates use Idempotency-Key; updates and deletes require a strong If-Match version. DELETE deactivates the record and retains historical relationships.

get.description: Requires faults.read. Delegated: exact scope faults.read AND one of roles Reader, Operator, Engineer, Administrator. Application: exact role Faults.Read.All. Caller kind: Either. Requires vehicles.read. Delegated: exact scope vehicles.read AND one of roles Reader, Operator, Engineer, Administrator. Application: exact role Vehicles.Read.All. Caller kind: Either. Alternatively exact vehicles.read.own scope AND Reader role; application own-read is unavailable. Trusted record authorization remains required. Requires drivers.read. Delegated: exact scope drivers.read AND one of roles Reader, Operator, Engineer, Administrator. Application: exact role Drivers.Read.All. Caller kind: Either. Alternatively exact drivers.read.own scope AND Reader role; application own-read is unavailable. Trusted record authorization remains required. Requires knowledge.read. Delegated: exact scope knowledge.read AND one of roles Reader, Operator, Engineer, Administrator. Application: exact role Knowledge.Read.All. Caller kind: Either. Daily quota: 200 authorized API requests per identity across all endpoints; resets at midnight UTC. Token refresh does not reset usage. Quota exhaustion returns 429 with Retry-After and X-RateLimit-Limit, X-RateLimit-Remaining and X-RateLimit-Reset headers. Vehicle-originated incidents. POST accepts vehicleId and code, creates an incident and linked notification, then attempts agent/MCP processing. Creation does not prove email delivery. PUT updates investigation status; resolving requires resolution notes (maximum 2000 characters), records them with author/time/version, indexes case evidence in Qdrant and queues an agent/MCP follow-up notification. An unknown fault can be resolved with recorded findings; this does not publish an approved fault definition or confirm vehicle repair. DELETE removes the record from normal reads while retaining audit and delivery history. Conditional mutations require If-Match and Idempotency-Key.

Caller kind: Either. Daily quota: 200 authorized API requests per identity across all endpoints; resets at midnight UTC. Token refresh does not reset usage. Quota exhaustion returns 429 with Retry-After and X-RateLimit-Limit, X-RateLimit-Remaining and X-RateLimit-Reset headers. Tenant-local ontology catalog of concepts, relationships and rules. Relationships must reference valid concepts. There is one current catalog per tenant. DELETE retires an unpublished catalog and retains history; published catalogs return 409 to protect pinned fault knowledge. The dashboard table remains read-only.

get.description: Requires vehicles.read. Delegated: exact scope vehicles.read AND one of roles Reader, Operator, Engineer, Administrator. Application: exact role Vehicles.Read.All. Caller kind: Either. Alternatively exact vehicles.read.own scope AND Reader role; application own-read is unavailable. Trusted record authorization remains required. Daily quota: 200 authorized API requests per identity across all endpoints; resets at midnight UTC. Token refresh does not reset usage. Quota exhaustion returns 429 with Retry-After and X-RateLimit-Limit, X-RateLimit-Remaining and X-RateLimit-Reset headers. Authorized tenant-filtered fleet records. Lists are paginated after ownership filtering. Vehicles include associated drivers visible to the caller and fault codes when knowledge.read is granted. Creates use Idempotency-Key; updates and deletes require a strong If-Match version. DELETE deactivates the record and retains historical relationships.
